record_type_quote: Association analysis focused on the SNP rs613872 in TFC4 , the most significantly associated SNP in the GWAS performed by Baratz and colleagues [29] . We also genotyped rs10490775 in PTPRG on chromosome 3, which was significant but not at a genome-wide level in the Baratz GWAS, to examine possible replication in our dataset.

targets.evidence_quote: Association analysis focused on the SNP rs613872 in TFC4 , the most significantly associated SNP in the GWAS performed by Baratz and colleagues [29] . We also genotyped rs10490775 in PTPRG on chromosome 3, which was significant but not at a genome-wide level in the Baratz GWAS, to examine possible replication in our dataset.
targets.outcome_quote: Although we replicated the association of rs613872 with FECD in our dataset, we failed to replicate the association with rs10490775 in PTPRG .
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit confirmation of one association and failure of the other from the same original paper. The title and abstract focus on TCF4, but do not override the explicit contrasting result for the other deliberately tested association.
